name: advanced polyglot 02 angular rust pricing
task: Extend the accumulated Vue and Python CMS workspace with an Angular-facing pricing presenter and a Rust pricing engine. Preserve all earlier implementation. Create web/angular/pricing.mjs exporting presentPrice(priceCents, currency='USD') using Intl.NumberFormat and rejecting non-integer or negative cents. Create rust/pricing.rs exporting pub fn volume_total_cents(unit_cents: u64, quantity: u32) -> Option<u64>, applying a 10 percent integer discount for quantity 10 or more and returning None on overflow; include focused Rust unit tests. Run the portable full suite with validate_project, review the final diff using git_operation, and report only evidence.
constraints: Create only web/angular/pricing.mjs and rust/pricing.rs; preserve Vue/Python files and harnesses.
Rust arithmetic must be checked and deterministic; do not use floating point for money.
Do not add dependencies or use OS-specific shell chaining.
Use validate_project and git_operation before completion.
workspaceInstructions: This stage expands the same workspace and validates JavaScript, Python, and Rust from one cross-platform Node orchestrator.
